retrieval_skill.name: regime_transition_evidence
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve evidence that separates a transient anomaly from the post-intervention process and establishes the regime governing the forecast horizon.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When an operational intervention may have changed the data-generating process before or at the forecast origin.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search jointly for the anomaly interval, its documented mechanism, intervention completion, and post-intervention validation; prioritize observations immediately preceding and following the forecast origin and classify evidence by mechanism and regime.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept the regime claim only when reliable evidence identifies the anomaly as temporary, confirms the intervention occurred before the forecast horizon, and directly characterizes post-intervention observations as stable; preserve exact temporal and provenance checks and do not infer stationarity from the intervention alone.
